messages:
ria: Short sync  issue: tiny gzipped safetensors shards causing warmup IO thrash; GPUs idle while IO saturates. Need coordinated backpressure + prioritize hydration.

matt: Seen in staging. We need inflight fetch caps per-host and per-request.

li: Can manifest carry priority hints for first shards? Edge-cached vs S3 matters.

ria: Proposal: manifest fields: priority_hint (int), compress ("gz"/"none"), estimated_uncompressed_bytes. Add hotstart_strategy and prefetch_budget_bytes.

sam: Must define abort rules: if OOM, cancel low-priority prefetches only.

nina: Streaming gz decode would reduce temp memory. Need cancelable decompressor.

warmup-bot: Note: warmup.fetch_attempts metric exists; no cancellation metric currently.

ria: Action plan: schema bump, loader inflight slots (global + per-request), decompressor cancellation API, metrics cancelled_prefetches and prefetch_latency_by_priority.

matt: Also add fallback_model_tag in manifest for routing fallback to smaller variant if high-priority shards miss X ms.

li: Dedicated can override prefetch_budget and slot counts; hosted uses defaults.

sam: Tests: throttling unit tests, S3 tail-latency integration test, perf harness to measure GPU idle.

nina: Security: include checksum/signature fields and verify before streaming to decompressor. Loader should ignore unknown fields for backward compat.

ria: I'll draft RFC with manifest diff and operator knobs. POC: loader + fake gz stream in a week; keep old behavior unless hints present.

matt: I'll start the prefetch-slot PR.

li: Ping me for Dedicated defaults and security checks.

warmup-bot: Reminder: warmup-queue-alert will need update if cancelled_prefetches metric added.

sam: Naming: prefer "hydration hints". :thumbsup:
